name: Bounded Fuji codec Rust adaptation and X-T5 matrix

portions.portion: X-Trans lossy/lossless codec logic and bitstream layout
X-T5 D65 matrix only; upstream Adobe attribution

modification: fuji.rs: memory-only bounded Rust adaptation of X-Trans 14-bit predictive codec, lossy/lossless; no FFI, file access, LibRaw calls or linkage. xt5.rs: nine constant matrix coefficients only. Not a clean-room implementation or measured TrueRenderer calibration.
source_distribution: This entire directory with source, manifest and license is bundled.
